              The environment is a very complex system and environmental problems involve many subjects across many fields. Solving environmental problems requires knowledge that is provided by the Department of Applied Chemistry. In this course, you will learn about the main aspects of environmental science, such as water science, engineering, and social science, and will acquire problem-solving skills.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This lecture is related to the examination of pollution control manager for water quality.

1 Water quality
 (1) Solids and dissolved matters
 (2) Organic substances
 (3) Eutrophication
 (4) Toxic substances
2 Water and wastewater treatment
 (1) Separation of particles
 (2) Membrane separation
 (3) Adsorption and ion exchange
 (4) Precipitation and oxidation
 (5) Activated sludge
 (6) Biofilm and anaerobic digestion
3 Water environment system
 (1) Water environment system
 (2) Water supply and sewage
